Common questions

How much does a party photographer cost?
Party photography is usually priced by the hour or as a short package. Australian pricing commonly starts from a few hundred dollars for a couple of hours. Request quotes to see real pricing for your celebration.
How far in advance should I book?
For weddings and peak-season events, popular photographers and videographers are often booked six to twelve months ahead. For smaller events a few weeks can be enough. The earlier you enquire, the more choice you have.
